Regular Planning Commission Meeting
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS
PLANNING COMMISSION
1245 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California 90631
06:30 p.m. Regular Business
May 23, 2023
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Planning Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on the agenda or other matters within the Planning Commission's purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings. In addition, each member of the public may also speak during the second Public Comment segment for no more than one minute concerning matters not on the agenda
To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speaker's card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak. Be advised that the Chair may limit speaking time at his discretion.
During a Public Hearing:
Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing item. Please provide a speaker's card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Chair. Your speaking time will be limited to the subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Chair may limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.
Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of TEN (10) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Commission.
In conjunction with Federal, State and Los Angeles County public health regulations, the public may physically attend Planning Commission meetings. Due to limited designated seating, members of the public will be allowed to enter on a first come, first served basis. To protect Committee members, members of the public, and staff, social distancing and face mask mandates will continue at City Hall at this time. The City will evaluate the current circumstances before each meeting to decide if it is safe to change ongoing COVID-19 safety protocols in place.
Members of the public may also go to www.Lhhcity.org to view the live broadcast of the Planning Commission meeting. For public comments, you may submit comments on any agenda item or item not on the agenda in writing via mail to City of La Habra Heights, ATTN: Planning Commission, 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631, email to Info@Lhhcity.org, or via phone at (562) 694-6302 Ext. 0. Please note that the Planning Commission is making every effort to follow the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access. It would be appreciated if communications of public comments are provided via mail, email or over the phone prior to the commencement of the meeting.

If you wish to appeal any decision of the Planning Commission, you must do so before 5:00 p.m. on the eleventh business day after the date of the action. Please contact the Community Development Department for information regarding the appeal process.
